notes: Prepared Drive now opens an empty tray automatically when that drive supports Open / Eject.
After the operator inserts a disc and manually closes the tray, Manager waits silently for 15 seconds after positive detection before starting the rip.
Prepared Drive never closes a tray automatically and shows no visible countdown.
Restored per-drive Supports Open / Eject and Supports Close capability settings under Hardware → Drives; unsupported controls are hidden.
Ejecting a failed, cancelled or completed disc now detaches its finished job from the live drive tile, so a replacement disc starts as Disc detected.
Fixed the simulator stale-state path so a newly inserted disc cannot instantly inherit Complete or Failed from the previous disc.
Every simulated replacement disc now receives a fresh disc-cycle identity; the existing 80% insertion and 10% rip-failure probabilities remain.
Bundled Rip Node API remains v0.2.5.
